BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The redirect target comes from a remote HTTP request.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Supplying an external URL is enough; no special conditions are needed.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No account is needed to craft the redirect link.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The victim must follow the crafted link.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the redirect and the user session.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Phishing through a trusted domain can expose limited user data.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Users can be led to a malicious site that imitates the application.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
